items.sql:
MERGE INTO APP.MERGE_TARGET t
USING (
    SELECT
        1001       AS ID,
        'new-body' AS BODY,
        1          AS ACTIVE_FLAG,
        0          AS DELETE_FLAG
    FROM DUAL
) s
ON (t.ID = s.ID)

WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET
        t.BODY       = s.BODY,
        t.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE
    WHERE s.ACTIVE_FLAG = 1
    DELETE WHERE s.DELETE_FLAG = 1

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
    INSERT (
        ID,
        BODY,
        UPDATED_AT
    )
    VALUES (
        s.ID,
        s.BODY,
        SYSDATE
    )
    WHERE s.ACTIVE_FLAG = 1;
